title: Night Side Songs is a new musical where they literally hand you a son...
transcript: There's a magic in watching a community form in real time, and that's what new musical night side songs does best, because in this show, the audience gets a songbook and is invited to sing along, turning a room full of strangers into a chorus and allowing everyone to lift each other up together there. I got to be in a video for the show with the writers of night side songs, the lazour brothers. I've been a big fan of their work and their music for a long time, so this was such an incredible experience. We gathered in the lincoln center lobby while they played and taught us the music. Within minutes, people who didn't know each other were together, harmonizing, laughing, and trying again. You could feel the space just come alive into. Nightside songs is a heavy show, but it also feels deeply universal. It's a story about illness, caretaking, and grief, but it's also one of love and living in the moment and how you build a life together. And it really is the singing that makes it feel so communal, because it doesn't matter how you sound or how loud you are. It's the act of singing together with the people around you that makes you feel less alone. Nightside songs is playing right now. Go and see it. I promise it'll stick with you for a very long time. And also go watch the video we made. I love it so much.
